use_cases: Settings and profile menu in SaaS applications
Quick actions toolbar for content management interfaces
Floating action panel for document or project management tools
User navigation menu with expandable sections
ai_summary: An expandable toolbar component featuring animated panels that reveal contextual content for each toolbar item. Uses Framer Motion spring animations for smooth transitions and includes click-outside detection for automatic panel closing. Icons from Lucide represent different sections like User, Messages, and Documents.
